notes: rust:1.40 (tc-rust). Default features (std). Lib unit tests + tests/*.rs; benches and doc-tests excluded (--lib --tests; harness cargo parser cannot parse doc-test names). Lockfile generated at setup; dev-dependency tree (criterion 0.3, rand 0.6, doc-comment) pinned to ~Oct-2019 versions buildable by rustc 1.40: criterion 0.3.0, criterion-plot 0.4.0, rayon 1.2.0, rayon-core 1.6.0, serde/serde_derive 1.0.101, serde_json 1.0.41, csv 1.1.1, bstr 0.2.8, clap 2.33.0, libc 0.2.65, syn 1.0.5, quote 1.0.2, proc-macro2 1.0.6, memchr 2.2.1, etc. (see setup_cmd). crossbeam-deque 0.7.4 / crossbeam-epoch 0.8.2 (2020) kept because 0.7.1 is unavailable. The library itself has no dependencies. build_cmd touches src so cargo never reuses a stale build after restore. RUSTFLAGS=--cap-lints=warn: lib.rs has #![deny(warnings, unused_results, ...)], which would turn the unused-parameter warnings of any stub/sabotaged body (and harmless lint differences in model code) into build errors; tests and behaviour are unaffected. Reproducibility: the exact dependency versions are fixed by the shipped lockfile benchmark/lockfiles/rust__rust-base64.Cargo.lock, which `tc.py setup` copies into the working copy; setup_cmd then only downloads them (cargo fetch --locked). `setup_cmd_generate` is the original command that produced that lockfile in Oct 2026 (it resolves unpinned dependencies against the live registry, so it is kept for provenance only).
